mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (member_login_id, member_password, member_name, member_email, member_phone, member_birth, member_gender, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberLoginId}, #{memberPassword}, #{memberName}, #{memberEmail}, #{memberPhone}, #{memberBirth}, #{memberGender}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT member_id, member_login_id, member_name, member_email, member_phone, member_birth, member_gender, created_at, updated_at FROM member
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET member_name = #{memberName}, member_phone = #{memberPhone}, member_birth = #{memberBirth}, member_gender = #{memberGender}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
